Class ProductModels

java.lang.Object
ecmwf.ecpds.master.plugin.http.controller.monitoring.ProductModels
public final class ProductModels extends Object
ECMWF Product Data Store (OpenECPDS) Project Product models: a model (e.g. "IFS" or "AIFS") is only identified by its unique name, and a product belongs to at most one model. Both are kept in the SYS_CONFIG table (groups "ProductModelName" for the model names and "ProductModel" for the product to model assignments), so no schema change is needed. Models are maintained from Admin Tasks → Product Descriptions and used to group and filter the products of the Delay Notification page.

    • save

      public static void save(String oldName, String name, Collection<String> products) throws DataBaseException, RemoteException
      Creates a model, or renames and updates the products of an existing one. The list of products is authoritative: the products of the model that are not in the list are removed from it, and the listed products that belong to another model are moved to this one.
      Parameters:
      oldName - the current name of the model to update, or null to create a new model
      name - the (new) unique name of the model
      products - the names of the products of the model
      Throws:
      RemoteException - on remote failure
      DataBaseException - if the name or a product is invalid, if the name is already used, or if the update fails
